sensitiveSeed.title: Your recovery phrase

disclaimer.title: Before you begin
disclaimer.intro: Nodekeeper helps you run your own Bitcoin node and manage ordinals. A few things to understand first:
disclaimer.selfCustody: This is self-custody. You alone hold your keys and your recovery phrase.
disclaimer.noRecovery: Nobody — including Nodekeeper — can recover your funds if you lose your recovery phrase. There is no "forgot password" option.
disclaimer.practiceFirst: Practice on Regtest first. It uses test coins with no real value, so you can try everything safely before using mainnet.
disclaimer.mainnetIsReal: Mainnet uses real bitcoin. Every mainnet transaction is real and, once broadcast, cannot be undone.

systemCheck.title: System check
systemCheck.diskUnknown: Could not determine free disk space
systemCheck.dataDirLabel: Data directory (bitcoind, ord, wallets, and logs are stored here -- can be an external drive)

binarySetup.title: Set up Bitcoin Core and ord
binarySetup.intro: Nodekeeper downloads these directly from their official sources and verifies them before use -- Bitcoin Core against its maintainers' checksums and signatures, ord against a hash Nodekeeper has pinned in advance. Nothing runs until it passes.

portInUse.title: Port already in use
portInUse.message: Another program (or another copy of Nodekeeper) is already using the port this node needs.
portInUse.whatToDo: Close the other program, or change this environment's port in settings, then try again.

diskFull.title: Disk space is low
diskFull.message: There isn't enough free disk space to continue safely.
diskFull.whatToDo: Free up space on this drive, or choose a different data directory with more room.

indexBehind.title: Index is behind
indexBehind.message: The ord index hasn't caught up to the node yet, so this feature isn't ready.
indexBehind.whatToDo: Wait for indexing to finish, then try again.

indexOptionDisabled.title: This feature needs an index option
indexOptionDisabled.message: This requires an index option that isn't enabled for this environment.
indexOptionDisabled.whatToDo: Enable the required index option in settings. Note: this means a full reindex.

walletLocked.title: Wallet is locked
walletLocked.message: This action needs the wallet unlocked first.
walletLocked.whatToDo: Unlock the wallet, then try again.

rpcWarmingUp.title: Node is still starting up
rpcWarmingUp.message: Bitcoin Core is warming up and isn't ready to answer requests yet.
rpcWarmingUp.whatToDo: Wait a moment and try again.

ordNotSynced.title: ord isn't caught up yet
ordNotSynced.message: This action needs ord to be fully synced with the node first.
ordNotSynced.whatToDo: Wait for ord to catch up, then try again.

binaryNotVerified.title: No verified Bitcoin Core binary
binaryNotVerified.message: Nodekeeper doesn't have a verified Bitcoin Core binary configured for this installation yet.
binaryNotVerified.whatToDo: Run the setup wizard to download and verify Bitcoin Core.

encryption.mainnetNotice: Mainnet wallets must be encrypted. Choose a passphrase you'll enter before every send -- this is different from your recovery phrase and cannot recover your funds on its own.
